assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production artwork for a premium Korean fantasy RPG clan-versus-clan war interface.
Style: high-end painterly semi-realistic 2D game key art; coherent cinematic lighting, beautiful precise materials, readable silhouettes and exquisite atmospheric depth, polished game illustration rather than a live-action photograph or plastic 3D render.
Constraints: no writing, no letters, no numbers, no UI, no border, no logo, no watermark. Anonymous adult fantasy squad members only, no existing named characters. Naturally flowing hair, no segmented plastic hair strands. Anatomically correct hands. Weapons have straight rigid coherent construction. No guns needed. Do not depict a territory map, relay tower, supply train or siege cannon.
Primary request: a cinematic wide clan war command chamber overlooking a close-scale arena where rival clan squads are about to face each other.
Scene: an exquisitely built midnight stone and bronze war room with a round tactical table in the foreground, blank crimson and blue standards, narrow shafts of light through tall windows. Across the far arched opening, a circular duel courtyard and two small disciplined groups can be seen.
Composition: ultra-wide panoramic 21:9, environmental establishing shot, low table in the foreground center, foreground edges softly shadowed, open center upper half for two clan crests and score UI composited later. No dominant close-up person, no giant battlefield or city.
Lighting and palette: deep ink navy, warm antique brass light, small cool teal highlights, atmospheric smoky amber rim lighting. Rich and prestigious rather than gaudy. Actual detailed art, not a diagram.
